verdict.rationale: Browser Use Cloud is an API platform, so scoped API credentials are a fair axis. The evidence only shows that API calls are authenticated with an API key header (APIKeyHeader). Nothing documents issuing keys limited by scope, permission, project or least privilege. Saved browser profiles and login state are adjacent features, not scoped API credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
